name: The Outside Eye
vestige: Yrrga, the eye that opened outside
summary: Truesight out to 30 ft. The price: Wisdom -2, and Disadvantage on saves against being Frightened, because now you see what's really there.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: Disguises, illusions, invisible things and borrowed shapes: up close, you see straight through all of them.

cost.flaw: You see what stands behind the world, close up, all the time. You have stopped sleeping in the dark.
cost.text: The truth is not good for the nerves.
